card.line: Thebez was a city north-east of Shechem where the wicked king Abimelech was killed by a woman with a millstone, an event the Bible remembers.

moments.title: Abimelech takes Thebez
moments.text: After destroying the tower of Shechem, Abimelech went to Thebez, camped against it, and captured it. The people fled into a strong tower inside the city.

moments.title: A woman's millstone
moments.text: As Abimelech came to set the tower on fire, a woman dropped an upper millstone on his head. He told his armor-bearer to kill him so no one could say a woman killed him, and he died. God repaid Abimelech for his wickedness.

moments.title: Joab remembers Thebez
moments.text: Joab told a messenger that David might ask why his men got so close to the wall, and to remind him of how Abimelech died at Thebez. The messenger was then to say that Uriah the Hittite was dead too.
